Carmen Velasquez: quick transfer — Atlas Health (Enterprise). Post-sign context: onboarding window ~3w, current health = medium (security review ongoing, data residency ask). Renewal flag: customer execs noted budget review in Q3 and must-have private-deploy option.

Anya Patel: thanks Carmen. assigning CS owner and capturing blockers. i'll own the onboarding timeline. can you drop the short checklist you shared in the deal?

Carmen Velasquez: pasted checklist below + link  — account doc: https://redwood.internal/accounts/atlas-health (internal)
- kickoff call (1) - infra provisioning (2) - SSO + SCIM (3) - private deploy eval (4) - prod test keys (5)

Jordyn Lee: I can triage the SSO/SCIM ask. starting an eng ticket now for private deploy feasibility.

Jordyn Lee: creating ticket:
```
Project: EN
Type: Spike
Summary: Atlas Health - private deploy feasibility & SSO integration
Assignee: Jordyn Lee
Priority: High
Notes: needs infra checklist from infra-team + estimated deploy timeline (air-gapped option?)
```

JiraBot: EN-5421 created by Jordyn Lee — https://jira.redwood/EN-5421

Tom R.: looping support: we should preload common connectors and share a minimal test plan. i'll add the test cases to EN-5421 and ping infra for quotas.

Anya Patel: next steps: (1) Carmen to intro Atlas PO + security contact (today) (2) Jordyn to validate private-deploy feasibility & estimate (EN-5421) (3) CS to schedule kickoff and 1st enablement session w/ customer (week of 3/30) (4) capture exec renewal signals and escalate if $$ reduces.

Carmen Velasquez: intro sent to Atlas PO (cc: Anya) — PO asked for tentative enablement dates.

Anya Patel: i booked a 30m enablement slot: Wed 3/31 10am PT. invite includes enablement playbook and collection form for feedback. please review docs before the call.

Jordyn Lee: EN-5421 updated with infra answers from Tom and initial ETA = 2.5 weeks for proof-of-concept private-deploy. adding label: customer-risk/renewal-watch.

Tom R.: added test cases and quota request. noted a potential blocker: internal compliance policy might require HSM for keys — flagging to security team.

Anya Patel: capturing feedback plan: we'll run the enablement + week-2 check-in, collect the one-pager success metrics, and add to account health dashboard. Carmen — please add any exec-level signals to this thread.

Carmen Velasquez: exec note: CFO wants cost estimate before next finance cycle (end of Q3). flagged with sales leadership.

Anya Patel: acknowledgement. i'll convert finance ask into a pricing follow-up and involve Solutions Eng. assigning owners: CS = Anya, ENG spike = Jordyn, Support = Tom.

Jordyn Lee: will update EN-5421 with consolidated notes and expected delivery date. marking this thread resolved for the immediate transfer but will post progress updates here. :thumbsup:

Tom R.: 👍

Anya Patel: thanks all — summarizing action items in the account doc and will ping when enablement materials are ready. :rocket:
